title: Surveillance, enforcement, and system-prohibition stress test
governing_question: Can APC-01 constrain a system that converts data, relationships, probabilities, geography, or risk indications into operational attention or coercive action while preserving bounded emergency authority and preventing fragmented responsibility, missing evidence, software-level nonremedy, and successor-system recurrence?

systems.case_name: M-J-M-A- et al. v. Wamsley et al.
systems.jurisdiction: United States — Oregon federal court and ICE field operations
systems.represented_population: People represented through immigration-nexus leads, geographic intelligence, plate and identity systems, field observation, and enforcement workflows
systems.institutional_action: ELITE-supported geographic selection contributed to an ICE operation followed by separate plate checks, observation, Mobile Fortify use, stop, arrest, detention, transport, litigation, and prospective arrest-practice relief.
systems.observed_control: Direct person-level litigation generated later evidence access, release activity, a preliminary burden shift, and classwide prospective limits on warrantless arrest practice.
systems.largest_limit: The record does not show pre-action notice, a complete ELITE action packet, individual identification by ELITE, software correction or deletion, compensation, community co-governance, durable system exit, or private-benefit reconciliation.

systems.jurisdiction: Netherlands — The Hague District Court and participating public bodies
systems.represented_population: People whose public-sector data could be combined into risk indications for fraud-related investigation or enforcement attention
systems.institutional_action: Public bodies combined data and generated risk indications under a statutory framework that the court found insufficiently transparent and verifiable and incompatible with Article 8 ECHR.
systems.observed_control: Collective claimants obtained independent proportionality review and system-level legal prohibition, removing the existing statutory basis for future use.
systems.largest_limit: The public record does not close direct person-level consequence, complete model and threshold access, deletion, compensation, operated alternatives, affected-party co-governance, or successor-system nonrecurrence.

domain_adapter.name: Inference-to-Intervention Covenant
domain_adapter.purpose: Apply APC-01 where a representation, query, match, relationship, score, risk indication, alert, target package, or geographic priority can produce investigation, stop, detention, search, denial, enforcement, or another coercive consequence.
covered_actions: watchlist, hotlist, risk, fraud, or threat indication
field deployment, stop, search, arrest, detention, transport, removal, or denial
automated or analyst-assisted recommendation that materially narrows operational attention
retention, correction, deletion, export, and successor-system reuse of the represented person's record
coercive_domain_invariants: The named public decision authority retains responsibility for the action even when a vendor, analyst, model, federated database, or separate agency supplies part of the chain.

Geographic prioritization, individual identification, relationship inference, risk indication, probable-cause judgment, and final field action are separate transitions and must be evidenced separately.
A human reviewer is constitutionally meaningful only when they receive the material basis, sufficient time, authority, institutional protection, and a logged ability to reject or narrow the action.
Serious and avoidable coercive action requires a complete action packet, independent authorization, and a preserved contestation route unless a bounded emergency exception applies.

Where pre-action person notice would create a specific imminent danger or defeat a lawful investigation, notice may be delayed but not eliminated; contemporaneous independent review, minimization, preservation, expiry, later notice, and remedy remain mandatory.
Missing or expired institutional records create an adverse presumption against the actor seeking to justify the coercive action when the represented person did not cause the loss.
Correction and deletion must reach vendor systems, agency systems, copies, exports, derived outputs, watchlists, models, target packages, and successor systems.
System-level prohibition is not complete remedy without shutdown, retention, deletion, person-level review, compensation where warranted, and successor-function testing.
Public-safety, immigration, fraud, national-security, and operational-efficiency purposes do not establish necessity, proportionality, accuracy, or lawfulness by themselves.

Collective litigation, advocacy, or union participation supplies voice and counterpower but does not establish standing co-governance over purpose, categories, thresholds, sharing, exceptions, or termination.
A vendor's configurable-software defense does not eliminate responsibility for design, default, support, data, model, integration, or custody contributions that materially shape the action chain.
A person-level injury and a system-level constitutional violation are distinct proof objects and may require different remedies.

r_level_tests.required_by_apc: Timely notice and direct voice before avoidable coercive action, or a documented delayed-notice exception with contemporaneous independent authorization and prompt later notice.
r_level_tests.elite_observation: The represented person experienced stop, arrest, detention, transport, and document presentation before litigation produced access to the operational record; no complete delayed-notice packet is public.
r_level_tests.syri_observation: The judicial record supports collective challenge to the framework, but the current estate lacks person-level notice, risk-report, consequence, and contestation files.

r_level_tests.required_by_apc: Access to source data, provenance, representation, query, model or rule version, threshold, user action, rationale, downstream copies, and correction and deletion routes.
r_level_tests.elite_observation: Court proceedings exposed testimony, body-camera and field evidence, and the distinction among ELITE, plate checks, observation, and Mobile Fortify; production ELITE queries, maps, configuration, audit, retention, correction, and deletion remain unavailable.
r_level_tests.syri_observation: The court found the framework insufficiently transparent and verifiable; complete project models, indicators, thresholds, versions, exceptions, individual risk reports, and access paths remain open.

r_level_tests.required_by_apc: An independently enforceable stay or restraint before avoidable coercive consequence, with the institution bearing authority, evidence, necessity, proportionality, and less-restrictive-alternative burdens.
r_level_tests.elite_observation: Preliminary and classwide relief imposed prospective arrest-practice limits, but it followed the represented person's stop and detention and did not itself stay ELITE use or correct the software record.
r_level_tests.syri_observation: Independent review shifted the burden at the framework level and led to prohibition, but person-level pre-investigation stays and project-level action packets remain absent.

r_level_tests.required_by_apc: Binding release, reversal, prohibition, restoration, deletion, compensation, systemic correction, and residual-injury review reaching public authorities, vendors, custodians, copies, and successors.
r_level_tests.elite_observation: Release and prospective arrest-practice relief are observed; final merits, compliance, record correction, deletion, compensation, and vendor-side change remain open.
r_level_tests.syri_observation: The existing legal basis could not continue to authorize SyRI, but shutdown, deletion, individual remedies, compensation, and successor-function recurrence remain unresolved.
missing: software and data correction or deletion

r_level_tests.required_by_apc: Durable termination or substitution with public capacity, preserved accountability, deletion, continuity, and no functionally equivalent successor dependency.
r_level_tests.elite_observation: Arrest-practice relief does not establish ELITE termination, replacement, migration, public independent operation, or post-exit custody.
r_level_tests.syri_observation: The legal framework was prohibited, but the complete shutdown, deletion, alternative fraud methods, operational outcomes, and successor architectures remain acquisition objects.

r_level_tests.required_by_apc: Affected people or accountable representatives hold binding authority over purpose, categories, threshold, data sharing, acceptable use, emergency exception, approval, suspension, or termination.
r_level_tests.elite_observation: Plaintiffs and a certified class obtained judicial counterpower over arrest practice, not standing co-governance over ELITE purpose, schema, thresholds, users, sharing, or deployment.
r_level_tests.syri_observation: Civil-society claimants, individuals, and a trade union successfully challenged the system, but the source set does not show an ongoing affected-party constitution capable of authoring or vetoing future systems.
missing: selection, removal, minority protection, resources, and conflicts
direct individual rights where collective representation is insufficient

r_level_tests.required_by_apc: Public and affected parties receive enforceable value, compensation, ownership, IP, license, governance, or institutional-capacity rights proportionate to authority, data, risk, injury, error, feedback, and learning supplied.
r_level_tests.elite_observation: The current record does not close compensation, public residual rights, vendor learning, defect correction, payment, IP, or affected-party distribution linked to the represented person.
r_level_tests.syri_observation: The court adjudicated legality and proportionality rather than a complete person-level loss, public-learning, private-benefit, or distribution ledger.
missing: cost, saving, revenue, IP, or capacity realization

action_packet_translation.burden_rule: The institution seeking avoidable coercive action bears the burden to establish lawful authority, material evidence, identity or category reliability, necessity, proportionality, and the insufficiency of less restrictive alternatives. A vendor output, risk indication, geographic priority, aggregate accuracy claim, or missing institutional record is not self-proving.
action_packet_translation.delayed_notice_rule: Pre-action person notice may be delayed only where a named independent authority finds a specific imminent risk of harm, flight, evidence destruction, or lawful investigative defeat. The exception is time-limited, minimized, logged, reviewed, and followed by notice and remedy when safe.
action_packet_translation.human_control_rule: A human approval counts as meaningful only when the human receives the material packet, has sufficient time and authority to reject, is protected from institutional pressure to ratify, records the reason, and remains legally and operationally responsible.

cross_system_controls.claim: ELITE supplies a bounded person-level control for action before ordinary review and later R3/R4 arrest-practice counterpower.
cross_system_controls.limit: ELITE geographic prioritization is not individual identification or sole causation, and the remedy does not close software governance.

cross_system_controls.claim: SyRI supplies a bounded system-level control for collective standing, independent proportionality review, and legal prohibition.
cross_system_controls.limit: The record does not close individual consequence, deletion, compensation, operated alternatives, or successor-system recurrence.

cross_system_controls.claim: ELITE and SyRI together prove that APC-01 works in surveillance and enforcement.
cross_system_controls.limit: The controls arise in different systems, jurisdictions, legal vehicles, consequences, evidence chains, and remedial levels.

cross_system_controls.claim: Serious coercive action requires separate proof of representation, inference, threshold, user, authority, and field consequence rather than one collapsed algorithmic-causation claim.
cross_system_controls.limit: A multi-input chain can still contain one indispensable or controlling component if exact evidence establishes it.

cross_system_controls.claim: A system-level prohibition is incomplete unless shutdown, deletion, person-level remedy, compensation, and successor-function review are separately reconciled.
cross_system_controls.limit: Some systems may lawfully retain records or continue distinct functions under independent authority.

cross_system_controls.claim: Collective litigation and successful challenge establish R6 co-governance.
cross_system_controls.limit: Counterpower in one dispute does not create an ongoing representative constitution over future purpose, categories, thresholds, sharing, exceptions, or termination.

propositions.claim: ELITE supplies a bounded person-level example of action before ordinary review and later R3/R4 arrest-practice counterpower without proving individual identification or sole causation.
propositions.falsifier: The complete file shows no material ELITE role, timely pre-action evidence and challenge, or no operative effect from the judicial relief.
propositions.stopping_rule: Keep geographic prioritization, individual identification, vendor role, and field authority separate.

propositions.claim: SyRI supplies a bounded system-level example of collective challenge and legal prohibition.
propositions.falsifier: The system continued unchanged, the legal basis remained operative, or the judgment produced no practical interruption.
propositions.stopping_rule: Do not infer person-level remedy, deletion, compensation, or nonrecurrence from prohibition alone.

propositions.claim: APC-COERCION-01 requires a complete inference-to-intervention action packet, meaningful human responsibility, and a bounded delayed-notice constitution.
propositions.falsifier: Observed testing shows the packet and review rules make urgent lawful action impossible or fail to improve evidence, proportionality, contestability, and remedy.
propositions.stopping_rule: Require one exact current deployment with timing, emergency, operational, rights, and outcome metrics.

propositions.claim: ELITE and SyRI together prove a composed APC-01 answer in surveillance and enforcement.
propositions.falsifier: One bounded deployment demonstrates the full R1-R7 stack, including durable anti-bypass and successor controls.
propositions.stopping_rule: Do not stack the two controls by analogy.

propositions.claim: Judicial prohibition or class relief establishes ongoing R6 affected-party co-governance.
propositions.falsifier: A durable representative constitution holds binding future authority over purpose, categories, thresholds, sharing, exceptions, and termination.
propositions.stopping_rule: Keep litigation standing, remedial authority, and ongoing constitutional authorship separate.

propositions.claim: The domain currently demonstrates R7 value recovery for represented people.
propositions.falsifier: An operative chain joins contribution or injury to enforceable residual rights, realized value, and affected-party distribution.
propositions.stopping_rule: Do not infer R7 from litigation, public learning, vendor revenue, system change, or compensation alone.

propositions.claim: APC-COERCION-01 is ready for a current-deployment pilot specification.
propositions.falsifier: The action packet, delayed-notice, independent review, evidence, remedy, exit, governance, or value rules are internally incompatible or legally impossible in the selected deployment.
propositions.stopping_rule: Select one exact deployment and freeze authority, users, source chain, timing, emergency conditions, record custody, remedies, costs, and operational metrics before piloting.

current_result.elite_positive_control: person-level consequence, delayed evidence access, and bounded R3/R4 arrest-practice relief
current_result.syri_positive_control: collective burden shift and system-level legal prohibition
current_result.highest_supported_domain_result: candidate inference-to-intervention covenant supported for pilot specification
current_result.next_step: Acquire one current coercive deployment suitable for an APC-COERCION-01 pilot and close software-level remedy, deletion, compensation, co-governance, value, and successor-system denominators.
